pages.note: The top of the page, under its own printed title บทขัดสิกขาบท 10. Two columns of one pāda each throughout, read across the row, eight rows. The rubric that introduces it is at the FOOT OF PAGE 56 and is already recorded there, so this row carries no block of its own.

The middle and foot of the page, under its own printed title สิกขาบท 10. Verses 1-4 are one run-on sentence set as justified prose across two printed lines, ending in a colon; verses 5-14 are the ten precepts, set one to a line and indented. Single column. A superscript ๑ sits on verse 14 with no footnote anywhere on the page.

chants.title_thai: บทขัดสิกขาบท 10
chants.title_english: The Introductory Verse to the Ten Training Rules

verses.pali: สัมพุทโธ โลเก อุปปันโน มะหาการุณิโก มุน,
verses.english: The Perfectly Awakened One, the greatly compassionate Sage, arose in the world,

verses.pali: ธัมมะจักกัง ปะวัตเตต๎วา โลเก อัปปะฏิวัตติยัง.
verses.english: and set rolling in the world the Wheel of Dhamma that none can turn back.

verses.pali: โลกัสสะ สังคะหัง กาตุง จะริต๎วา โลกะจาริกัง,
verses.english: To show kindness to the world he walked the world on his journeys,

verses.pali: ติวิธัง โลเก สัทธัมมัง สัมมะเทวะ ปะวัตติยัง.
verses.english: setting the threefold true Dhamma rightly going in the world.

verses.pali: อะนุปุพเพนะ สาวัตถิง ปัต๎วา เชตะวะเน วะสัง,
verses.english: Coming in due course to Sāvatthī and dwelling in the Jeta Grove,

verses.pali: สามะเณรานัง นิสสายะ จิตตัง กะถานุสิกขิตุง.
verses.english: and having regard for the novices' minds, and for how they were to train,

verses.pali: อะนุญญาสิ ทะสะ สิกขา สามะเณเรหิ สิกขิตุง,
verses.english: he allowed ten trainings for novices to train in;

verses.pali: สามะเณรานัง ทะสังคัง สิกขาปะทัง ภะณามะ เส.
verses.english: let us now recite the tenfold training rule of the novices.

vocabulary.pali: ธัมมะจักกัง ปะวัตเตต๎วา
vocabulary.meaning: having set the Wheel of Dhamma rolling — the phrase for the first teaching at Isipatana

vocabulary.pali: อัปปะฏิวัตติยัง
vocabulary.meaning: not to be turned back; once set going, nothing can reverse it
kindness, help, the gathering of others in — what the Buddha's journeying was for

vocabulary.pali: สามะเณรานัง
vocabulary.meaning: of the novices — those ordained under the ten training rules rather than the full code

checks.issue: The book prints มุน, not มุนี. Checked at 6x: the น carries no vowel sign at all, and the ณิ of การุณิโก two words earlier on the same line shows its ิ perfectly clearly at that size, so the absence is real and not lost in the printing. Standard editions have munī, "the Sage". Reproduced AS PRINTED and transliterated mun to match. This looks like a slip in this edition, but only the physical book can say.

The 10 in the title บทขัดสิกขาบท 10 is part of the TITLE — the ten training rules — and not a chant number. The book's chant numbers are printed before the title and followed by a full stop; this one comes after the title words with no full stop. No book_number recorded.

TWO-COLUMN READING, please confirm. The whole chant is set in two columns and has been read ACROSS the row. The first pairing made is verse 1: left cell สัมพุทโธ โลเก อุปปันโน + right cell มะหาการุณิโก มุน.

จิตตัง กะถานุสิกขิตุง is printed as one word from กะถา onward and the syntax of the whole row is not straightforward. The English given is a working reading — "having regard for the novices' minds, and for how they were to train" — taking กะถานุสิกขิตุง as kathā + anusikkhituṃ. This line is worth Josh's eye more than any other in the chant.

working_notes.invitation: printed inside the prose rubric above the title — the senior sāmaṇera begins with อะนุญญาสิ โข — and recorded there rather than in the invitation field, so the page shows it once. The chant is also invited by the last line of บทขัดสิกขาบท 10 above it.
working_notes.units: Fourteen. Verses 1-4 divide the opening sentence at its printed commas, as the rubric directs; verses 5-14 are the ten precepts, one to a printed line.
working_notes.pages: IMG_0320.PNG (page 57), Thai script, single column, the middle and foot of the page. The chant begins and ends on this page.

verses.pali: อะนุญญาสิ โข,
verses.english: He allowed —

verses.pali: โส ภะคะวา,
verses.english: that Blessed One —

verses.pali: สามะเณรานัง ทะสะ สิกขาปะทานิ,
verses.english: ten training rules for novices,

verses.pali: เตสุ จะ สามะเณเรหิ สิกขิตุง:
verses.english: and that novices should train in them:

verses.pali: ปาณาติปาตา เวระมะณี,
verses.english: refraining from killing living beings,

verses.pali: อะทินนาทานา เวระมะณี,
verses.english: refraining from taking what is not given,

verses.pali: อะพ๎รัห๎มะจะริยา เวระมะณี,
verses.english: refraining from unchaste conduct,

verses.pali: มุสาวาทา เวระมะณี,
verses.english: refraining from false speech,

verses.pali: สุราเมระยะมัชชะปะมาทัฏฐานา เวระมะณี,
verses.english: refraining from liquor, wine and intoxicants, which are the ground of heedlessness,

verses.pali: วิกาละโภชะนา เวระมะณี,
verses.english: refraining from eating at the wrong time,

verses.pali: นัจจะคีตะวาทิตะวิสูกะทัสสะนา เวระมะณี,
verses.english: refraining from dancing, singing, music and unseemly shows,

verses.pali: มาลาคันธะวิเลปะนะธาระณะมัณฑะนะวิภูสะนัฏฐานา เวระมะณี,
verses.english: refraining from wearing garlands, scents and cosmetics, and from adorning and beautifying the body,

verses.pali: อุจจาสะยะนะมะหาสะยะนา เวระมะณี,
verses.english: refraining from high and large beds,

verses.pali: ชาตะรูปะระชะตะปะฏิคคะหะณา เวระมะณีติ.
verses.english: refraining from accepting gold and silver.

vocabulary.meaning: refraining, abstention — the training is put as what one steps back from, not as a command

vocabulary.pali: วิกาละโภชะนา
vocabulary.meaning: eating at the wrong time — after midday until the following dawn

vocabulary.pali: วิสูกะทัสสะนา
vocabulary.meaning: watching shows and entertainments; visūka carries the sense of something at odds with the practice

vocabulary.pali: อุจจาสะยะนะมะหาสะยะนา
vocabulary.meaning: high beds and large beds — luxury in sleeping, not comfort as such

vocabulary.pali: ชาตะรูปะระชะตะ
vocabulary.meaning: gold and silver; in practice the rule covers money of any kind

checks.issue: A superscript ๑ is printed after เวระมะณีติ. — and there is NO footnote anywhere on page 57. The foot of the page holds only the instruction line, with clear white paper below it. Footnote numbers restart on every page, so the note is not to be matched to one on another page. source_printed is deliberately left out. Please check whether the book prints the note on page 58 or whether the marker is an artefact of this edition.
The 10 in the title สิกขาบท 10 is part of the TITLE, not a chant number, on the same reasoning as the chant above. No book_number recorded.

LAYOUT is mixed and the layout key is deliberately left OFF. Verses 1-4 are run-on justified prose; verses 5-14 are set one precept to a line. Setting layout to prose would flow the ten precepts into a block, which is further from the page than leaving them as lines, so the lines win. The only loss is that verses 1-4 show as four lines where the book runs them together. If Josh wants that exact, the app needs a layout that can change part way through a chant.
The book prints a COLON at the end of this verse, not a comma or a full stop — เตสุ จะ สามะเณเรหิ สิกขิตุง: — introducing the list. Reproduced as printed.

Both have printed titles, and both titles END in an Arabic 10 that belongs to the title rather than being a chant number — worth saying twice because a number beside a title is exactly what gets misread as one.
